values.title: Collaboration and Interdisciplinarity
values.description: Our strength stems from the convergence of diverse fields of knowledge—Electrical and Computer Engineers, Mechanical Engineers, as well as students from the Departments of Economics, Computer Science, Education, and other specialties at the University of Thessaly. Close collaboration and mutual respect among members with different profiles and perspectives enable us to create innovative and multifaceted solutions in the realm of science.

values.title: Professionalism and Dedication
values.description: We approach challenges with seriousness, methodical planning, and responsibility. Every project, every approach, and every collaboration represents an opportunity for us to rise to the occasion and earn the trust of the academic and professional community.

values.title: Learning Evolution and Personal Development
values.description: Participating in StarBound is much more than just an activity. It is a space for education, experimentation, trial and error, learning, developing technical skills, soft skills, and inventiveness. Through workshops, project development, and collaborations, we bridge theory with practice and transform knowledge into meaningful action, giving every member the opportunity to grow.

values.title: Innovation and Goal-Orientation
values.description: We are not limited to reproducing known solutions. We seek original, bold, and sustainable ideas, from building a UAV to experimenting with space technology.

values.title: Social Responsibility and a Sustainable Future
values.description: We believe that science and research must coexist with social awareness. The development of technologies that respect the environment—such as recyclable materials, reusable systems, energy efficiency, and partial or total reduction of environmental footprint—as well as the dissemination of knowledge to the wider public, are integral elements of our mission.

mission.title: Our Mission
paragraphs: We are committed to advancing aerospace technology and fostering public interest in the space sector. We envision the creation of a state-of-the-art and innovative educational center that bridges theory and hands-on experience. Our team consists of members from multiple departments, all collaborating to create and promote impactful interdisciplinary projects. By combining diverse academic backgrounds and skill sets, we are able to approach challenges from multiple perspectives and develop well-rounded, effective solutions.
Here are the departments contributing to our initiatives under the support of our local IEEE student branch:
departments: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering
Department of Computer Science and Telecommunications
